description: Batch delete parts in framings clients actually send: CRLF with no blank line after the inner headers, LF-only lines, and the blank-line control. Only statuses compare: each side picks its own multipart boundary and envelope headers, and the per-object GET after each batch shows whether the delete happened.

steps.name: batch-crlf-blank-line
steps.body_text:
--framing
Content-Type: application/http
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
Content-ID: <a>

DELETE /storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o/{object}-a HTTP/1.1


--framing--

steps.name: batch-crlf-no-blank-line
steps.body_text:
--framing
Content-Type: application/http
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
Content-ID: <b>

DELETE /storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o/{object}-b HTTP/1.1
Accept: application/json

--framing--

steps.name: batch-lf-only
steps.body_text:
--framing
Content-Type: application/http
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
Content-ID: <c>

DELETE /storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o/{object}-c HTTP/1.1


--framing--

steps.name: batch-request-line-only
steps.body_text:
--framing
Content-Type: application/http
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
Content-ID: <d>

DELETE /storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o/{object}-d HTTP/1.1
--framing--
